title: Emerald Orbs at Dusk
description: Three reflective green spheres of varying sizes rest on a glossy green surface, mirroring the dark gothic city skyline and a large white crescent moon. The background features a dramatic blood-red and purple sky above a silhouetted fantasy castle with numerous spires.
prompt: surreal fantasy painting of three glossy emerald green spheres of different sizes resting on a reflective green ground, perfectly mirroring the scene, dark gothic city with many sharp spires and towers silhouetted against a dramatic red and purple gradient sky, large bright white crescent moon hanging in the sky, high contrast, moody atmosphere
